initial_message: I cannot connect to the VPN after the laptop rebuild. Error 809.
resolution_summary: Reinstall the corporate VPN client, set protocol to IKEv2, then reconnect. If Error 809 persists, reset WAN miniport adapters and retry. Escalate to network team if still failing after 15 minutes.

initial_message: I need admin rights on my laptop to install Docker Desktop for a project.
resolution_summary: Do not grant permanent local admin. Create a time-bound privileged elevation request (max 8 hours), require manager approval, install Docker via Software Center if available, then revoke elevation.

initial_message: Outlook keeps asking for password every 10 minutes on Windows 11.
resolution_summary: Clear cached Outlook credentials from Windows Credential Manager, repair Office click-to-run, re-add the mailbox profile, and confirm Modern Auth is enabled.

initial_message: My laptop battery drains to 0% in under 2 hours even on power saver.
resolution_summary: Run battery report, check for swollen battery, update BIOS and chipset drivers, calibrate battery once. If capacity health is below 60%, raise hardware replacement ticket.

initial_message: Wi-Fi connects but internal SharePoint sites will not load.
resolution_summary: Verify user is on corporate SSID not guest, check proxy auto-config, flush DNS, renew IP. If only internal sites fail, reset Always-On VPN tunnel and retest.

initial_message: Please reset MFA for my account. I lost my phone and cannot log in.
resolution_summary: Verify caller identity via HR employee ID and manager callback. Reset MFA in IdP, force re-registration on next login, and log the identity verification steps. Requires human approval.

initial_message: Teams notifications are silent even though status is Available.
resolution_summary: Check Windows Focus Assist, Teams notification settings, OS notification permissions for Teams, and restart Teams in clear-cache mode.

initial_message: Laptop will not power on after a Windows update last night.
resolution_summary: Attempt power reset (hold power 30s), boot to BIOS, try Windows Recovery. If no POST, dock with external monitor test. Open break-fix replacement if hardware failure confirmed.

initial_message: Printer on Floor 3 is offline for everyone in my team.
resolution_summary: Check printer queue server status, bounce the print spooler on the floor print server, verify printer IP ping, and republish the queue if needed.

initial_message: I joined last week and cannot access the Finance shared drive.
resolution_summary: Confirm HR provisioning completed, validate AD group membership for Finance-Share-RO, trigger group sync, then map drive. If still denied after sync, open IAM ticket.

initial_message: Python virtualenv activation fails with execution policy error on PowerShell.
resolution_summary: Set CurrentUser execution policy to RemoteSigned, unblock the Activate.ps1 script, and retry. Document for developer onboarding FAQ.

initial_message: Citrix desktop session disconnects every few minutes.
resolution_summary: Check MTU and Wi-Fi stability, disable UDP for Citrix if on unstable network, update Citrix Workspace, and collect CDF traces if reproducible on wired network.

initial_message: Need production database read access for incident investigation.
resolution_summary: Grant temporary read-only role for 4 hours only after incident bridge approval. Log ticket ID in PAM system. Auto-expire access. Always requires human approval.

initial_message: External USB headset is not detected after docking.
resolution_summary: Try alternate USB-C port, update dock firmware, reinstall audio driver, test headset on another machine to isolate dock vs headset fault.

initial_message: Excel crashes when opening a large Power Query workbook.
resolution_summary: Repair Office, disable hardware graphics acceleration, update Power Query, and open in Safe Mode to isolate add-in conflict.

initial_message: Cannot reach github.company.com from home VPN; office network works.
resolution_summary: Confirm split-tunnel routes include corp GitHub CIDR, refresh VPN profile, flush DNS. If route missing, update VPN config package and redistributed profile.

initial_message: Shared mailbox Finance-Invoices is missing in Outlook.
resolution_summary: Add shared mailbox via Exchange permissions check, ensure FullAccess + AutoMapping, then restart Outlook. If permission missing, request owner approval.

initial_message: Laptop fan runs loud under light load after dust cleaning.
resolution_summary: Update BIOS, check thermal paste service history, run stress test with HWMonitor. If thermal throttling abnormal, escalate to depot for heatsink service.

initial_message: Company SSO login loop on Chrome for all SaaS apps.
resolution_summary: Clear cookies for IdP domain, disable conflicting password extensions, try Incognito. If org-wide, check IdP status page and open major incident.

initial_message: Slow file copy to network share only on Wi-Fi.
resolution_summary: Test on wired, check Wi-Fi band (prefer 5GHz), disable large-send offload temporarily, and verify SMB multichannel. Replace AP if floor-wide symptom.
